verdict.rationale: DeepSeek has a public pricing page in its docs (quick_start/pricing) with per-model tables, and community users mention the low API cost and recent price cuts. That points to self-serve public pricing rather than sales-gated pricing. However, none of the evidence quotes actual per-token rates or confirms that every current model, such as V4.1 Flash or the Vision-Exp model, is listed. Missing for 10: quoted per-token input/output prices, confirmation that all current models are covered on the pricing page, independent corroboration of the listed rates.
